title: Persona Steering and Generation
summary: This module encompasses the entire lifecycle of persona steering, from defining and evaluating persona traits to generating steered model responses and analyzing their effects. It provides tools for creating, testing, and applying persona vectors to influence large language model behavior.

nodes.label: Define Persona Schemas
nodes.title: Define Persona Schemas
nodes.description: Establishes the data structures for persona traits, including prompts, questions, and evaluation rubrics, ensuring consistent data representation.

nodes.label: Evaluate & Vectorize Personas
nodes.title: Evaluate & Vectorize Personas
nodes.description: Generates persona trait artifacts, evaluates them through rollouts, and creates numerical persona vectors for steering.

nodes.label: Compose & Analyze Vectors
nodes.title: Compose & Analyze Vectors
nodes.description: Provides utilities for combining, calibrating, and analyzing steering vectors, including orthogonalization and cosine similarity.

nodes.label: Apply Steering Mechanisms
nodes.title: Apply Steering Mechanisms
nodes.description: Implements the core logic for applying persona vectors to influence model activations and generate steered responses.

nodes.label: Generate Response Grids
nodes.title: Generate Response Grids
nodes.description: Creates grids of model responses by steering along multiple persona vectors, useful for exploring behavioral landscapes like D&D alignments.

nodes.label: Test & Validate Steering
nodes.title: Test & Validate Steering
nodes.description: Offers tools for validating persona vectors, performing sanity checks, A/B testing, and evaluating the stability and effectiveness of steering.

nodes.label: Optimize Coherence
nodes.title: Optimize Coherence
nodes.description: Performs alpha sweeps to determine optimal scaling factors for persona traits, ensuring coherent and balanced steering effects.

nodes.label: Chat Interface
nodes.title: Chat Interface
nodes.description: The user-facing API endpoints that utilize persona steering for interactive chat experiences.

groups.label: Persona Definition & Creation
groups.title: Persona Definition and Creation
groups.description: This group handles the initial stages of persona development, from defining their structural schemas to generating and vectorizing their core traits.

groups.label: Steering Logic & Application
groups.title: Steering Logic and Application
groups.description: This group focuses on the core mechanisms for manipulating and applying persona vectors to influence model behavior, including advanced vector composition and grid-based response generation.

groups.label: Evaluation & Optimization
groups.title: Evaluation and Optimization
groups.description: This group provides tools for rigorously testing, validating, and optimizing the effectiveness and coherence of persona steering mechanisms.

groups.label: User Interaction
groups.title: User Interaction
groups.description: This group represents the interface through which users interact with the persona-steered language models.
